tools.name: search_memory

query.description: Search query (entity name). Required unless entity_id is provided.

entity_type.description: Entity type filter. If not provided, searches all entities.

entity_id.description: Entity ID for direct lookup. Can be used instead of query for exact fetch.

min_similarity.description: Minimum similarity threshold for fuzzy matching (0.0-1.0)

include_connections.description: Include connection details in response (max 20, active first)

include_content.description: Include semantic content search results alongside entity matches (default: true). Uses the query for vector similarity search across all content in the organization.

content_limit.description: Max content results when include_content is enabled (default: 5, max: 50)

query_embedding.description: Embedding vector for semantic similarity search. When provided, results are ranked by cosine similarity.

metadata_filter.description: Filter entities by metadata key-value pairs (e.g. {"category": "preference"})

agent_id.description: Limit results to memory written by this agent. Filters events where `metadata.agent_id` matches the given id. Agents that opt in (via the `@lobu/openclaw-plugin` autoCapture path) get their saves stamped with their own id automatically; pass the same id here to scope recall to that agent's own writes.

include_public_catalogs.description: Also search public-catalog orgs (visibility=public) — canonical world entities like HMRC, banks, currencies. Defaults to true so agents can discover entities to reference cross-org.

tools.description: Search saved workspace memory: entities, facts, decisions, preferences, observations, and notes. Use this to answer “what do we know?” Pair writes with `save_memory`; use `search_sdk` / `query_sdk` only when you need SDK capabilities or programmable reads.

tools.name: save_memory

entity_ids.description: Entity IDs to associate content with. Omit for org-scoped content.

content.description: The text content to save. Required for text/markdown payload types.

semantic_type.description: Semantic type (e.g. note, summary, decision, identity, observation). Preferred.

payload_type.description: Content format. 'text' (default): plain text. 'markdown': rendered as rich text. 'json_template': rendered via payload_template + payload_data. 'media': media-focused display. 'empty': metadata only.

payload_data.description: Structured data object. Used as template data for json_template, or structured metadata for media.

payload_template.description: JSON template for rendering. Required when payload_type is json_template. Must have a { root: ... } structure.

attachments.description: Array of attachment objects (e.g. files, images).

source_url.description: URL of the original source for this content.

occurred_at.description: When the event actually happened (ISO 8601). Defaults to now if omitted.

metadata.description: Structured metadata — validated against the entity type schema or semantic_type schema

supersedes_event_id.description: ID of an existing event this content replaces (e.g. updated preference, corrected fact). The old event is marked as superseded and excluded from future searches.

watcher_source.description: Attribution source when save is triggered by a watcher reaction

tools.description: Save user-shared facts, preferences, decisions, observations, and notes to workspace memory. Storage is append-only — pass `supersedes_event_id` to replace an existing fact (the old event is hidden from future searches without losing history). Optionally attach to entities via `entity_ids`. Always search first to avoid duplicates.

tools.name: list_organizations

search.description: Filter organizations by name (case-insensitive substring match)

tools.description: List organizations the authenticated user belongs to, plus any public workspaces the session can read. The response marks the bound org with `is_current: true` — that is the default target for memory and SDK calls. Use the slug with `client.org(slug)` from `query_sdk` / `run_sdk` for cross-org reads on /mcp + OAuth, or reconnect to /mcp/{slug} to pin a different default.

tools.name: search_sdk

query.description: Method-discovery query. Use a namespace name (e.g. 'watchers') for a listing, a dotted path (e.g. 'watchers.create') for a drill-down, or a free-text term to substring-match across paths and summaries.

limit.description: Max matches to return. Default 20, max 100.

tools.description: Search ClientSDK documentation and method metadata. Use this to discover which SDK method exists and how to call it; it does not query workspace data. Pass a namespace ('watchers', 'entities', etc.), a dotted path ('watchers.create'), or a free-text query. Pair with `query_sdk` (read-only) or `run_sdk` (full SDK) to actually call methods.

tools.name: query_sdk

script.description: TypeScript source. Must `export default async (ctx, client) => { ... }`. Use `search_sdk` to discover SDK methods.

tools.description: Run read-only TypeScript in a sandboxed isolate over the ClientSDK. Use this to fetch workspace data through typed SDK methods. The script signature is `export default async (ctx, client) => ...`. Mutating methods are absent from `client` — attempts surface as undefined methods; use `run_sdk` for writes. Output capped at 1 MB. Use `search_sdk` to find method names. Example: `export default async (_ctx, client) => client.entities.list({ entity_type: "company" });`

tools.name: list_metrics

entity_type.description: Filter to one entity type slug (e.g. "company").

q.description: Keyword filter (case-insensitive) over measure/dimension/segment names + descriptions.

tools.description: List the DECLARED, governed metrics — measures / dimensions / segments (with descriptions) per entity type. Use this FIRST to discover what metrics exist; pass `q` to keyword-search. Then run one with `query_metric`. Prefer governed metrics over hand-written `query_sql` so numbers stay consistent.

tools.name: query_metric

entity_type.description: Entity type slug that declares the metric (e.g. "company"). See list_metrics.

measure.description: Declared measure name on that entity type (e.g. "spend").

by.description: Dimension names to group by (e.g. ["currency","month"]). Omit for a grand total per entity.

segment.description: An extra declared segment (named population filter) to AND in.

entity_id.description: Restrict to a single entity (entities.id); omit for all entities of the type.

tools.description: Run a DECLARED metric (discover them via `list_metrics`) and get its rows: pass entity_type + measure, optional `by` dimensions / `segment` / `entity_id`. The metric layer enforces resolution, dedupe, segment, and aggregation, so results are consistent and governed. PREFER this over `query_sql` whenever a declared measure answers the question; fall back to `query_sql` only when no metric covers the ask.

tools.name: query_sql

sql.description: Base SELECT query. Table references are auto-scoped to your organization. It is wrapped as a subquery, so ORDER BY / LIMIT / window functions inside it are fine; pagination + sort are added on the outside via sort_by/limit/offset.

connection.description: Optional connection slug. When set, `sql` runs LIVE (read-only) against that connection’s external database via its connector (pushdown), and the internal org-scoping is skipped. When unset, the query runs over your org’s internal tables.

org_slug.description: Optional. Only honored on the unscoped `/mcp` endpoint with OAuth auth. Rejected for PAT auth, browser-session auth, and scoped `/mcp/{slug}` connections — re-connect to the target workspace instead.

sort_by.description: Column name to sort by. Omit to return rows unordered (e.g. a view whose columns you don't know upfront).

search_columns.description: Columns to search across (required when search_term is set).

tools.description: Run a paginated, sortable, searchable read-only SQL query. Table references auto-scope to the bound org. The query is wrapped as a subquery, so inner ORDER BY / LIMIT / window functions are fine; pagination + sort come from the sort_by/limit/offset args. Do NOT use positional parameters ($1, $2, …). Optional `org_slug` (OAuth on /mcp only) redirects the query to a different member org; rejected on /mcp/{slug} and on PAT auth. NOTE: this is the FALLBACK — if a declared metric covers the ask, use `query_metric` (see `list_metrics`) instead, so numbers match the governed definitions.

tools.name: metric_series

sql.description: A single SELECT (or WITH … SELECT) returning a bucket column plus one or more numeric stat columns. Table references are auto-scoped to the caller's organization; `$1` is the organization id (injected — do not pass it).

tools.description: Run a read-only time-series SQL for dashboard sparklines. Caller passes a single SELECT returning a bucket column + N numeric stat columns; the same validator/auto-scoper that powers `query_sql` injects `$1 = organization_id`. Returns `{ columns, rows }` for direct frontend consumption.

tools.name: run_sdk

script.description: TypeScript source. Must `export default async (ctx, client) => { ... }`. Use `search_sdk` to discover SDK methods.

dry_run.description: Preview mode. Read SDK calls still execute, but write/external SDK calls are skipped and returned in side_effect_preview.

tools.description: Destructive — confirm before running. Runs TypeScript in a sandboxed isolate over the FULL ClientSDK. Use this for SDK writes or multi-step workflows. Signature: `export default async (ctx, client) => ...`. Can mutate entities, watchers, memory, classifiers, connections, etc. Use `query_sdk` for reads. Pass `dry_run: true` to execute reads while skipping write/external SDK calls and returning `side_effect_preview`. Output capped at 1 MB. Example: `export default async (_ctx, client) => client.entities.create({ type: "company", name: "Acme" });`

schema_type.description: Whether to manage entity types or relationship types

event_kinds.description: [entity_type: create/update] Event semantic types this type produces, keyed by semantic_type slug. Each entry can have a description, optional metadataSchema (JSON Schema), and optional jsonTemplate (render template). `null` clears all kinds; omit to leave unchanged.

backing.description: [entity_type: create/update] Makes the type DERIVED — a read-only SQL view. `{ sql }` runs over your org's internal tables; `{ sql, connection: <slug> }` runs LIVE against that connection's external database (read-only, no copy). `null` clears it (revert to a stored type); omit to leave unchanged. connection.description: Optional connection slug. When set, the view runs LIVE against that connection’s external database (read-only, no copy) instead of internal tables. Stored verbatim; resolved to the connection at read time.

metrics_config.description: [entity_type: create/update] Declared metric contract (eventSets/measures/dimensions/segments — see @lobu/connector-sdk) stored verbatim. The metric compiler lowers it into backing SQL. `null` clears it; omit to leave unchanged.

status.description: [relationship_type: create/update] Status. Default active.

auto_create_when.description: [relationship_type: create/update] Identity-engine auto-derivation rules stored on relationship_type.metadata.autoCreateWhen

entity_id.description: Entity ID. Optional for create — provide it to attach the watcher to an entity; omit it for an org-scoped/global watcher. Optional for list.

keying_config.description: [create/create_version] Config for stable key generation across windows.

agent_kind.description: [create/update] Optional agent kind override for this watcher (e.g. "background", "notifier"). Null clears the override.

notification_priority.description: [create/update] Priority class used by the dispatcher interrupt budget. Default "normal".

min_cooldown_seconds.description: [create/update] Minimum seconds between two firings of this watcher (0 = no cooldown).

reactions_guidance.description: [create/create_version] Guidance text for LLM agents on what reactions to take.

replace_existing.description: [complete_window] Replace existing window for same period (default: false).

model.description: [complete_window] Optional model name used to produce the window result.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

after_id.description: Stable tie-breaker for after_occurred_at. Only used when sort_by=date and sort_order=desc.

interaction_status.description: Filter by interaction status (e.g. "pending" for pending approvals)

schema_type.description: Whether to manage entity types or relationship types

event_kinds.description: [entity_type: create/update] Event semantic types this type produces, keyed by semantic_type slug. Each entry can have a description, optional metadataSchema (JSON Schema), and optional jsonTemplate (render template). `null` clears all kinds; omit to leave unchanged.

backing.description: [entity_type: create/update] Makes the type DERIVED — a read-only SQL view. `{ sql }` runs over your org's internal tables; `{ sql, connection: <slug> }` runs LIVE against that connection's external database (read-only, no copy). `null` clears it (revert to a stored type); omit to leave unchanged. Read a derived type's rows by running its `backing_sql` (returned by `get`) through `query_sql` — and when `get` also returns a `backing_source`, pass it as `query_sql`'s `connection` so the view runs against the external DB instead of your internal tables. `get` also returns `measure_columns` (the view's aggregate columns, classified on read).

connection.description: Optional connection slug. When set, the view runs LIVE against that connection’s external database (read-only, no copy) instead of internal tables. Stored verbatim; resolved to the connection at read time.

metrics_config.description: [entity_type: create/update] Declared metric contract (eventSets/measures/dimensions/segments — see @lobu/connector-sdk) stored verbatim. The metric compiler lowers it into backing SQL. `null` clears it; omit to leave unchanged.

is_symmetric.description: [relationship_type: create] Whether the relationship is symmetric (A↔B = B↔A). Default false.

inverse_type_slug.description: [relationship_type: create/update] Slug of the inverse relationship type (e.g., "depends_on" ↔ "dependency_of")

status.description: [relationship_type: create/update] Status. Default active.

auto_create_when.description: [relationship_type: create/update] Identity-engine auto-derivation rules stored on relationship_type.metadata.autoCreateWhen

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

before_occurred_at.description: Chronological cursor anchor for older results. Pair with before_id. Only used when sort_by=date and sort_order=desc.

before_id.description: Stable tie-breaker for before_occurred_at. Only used when sort_by=date and sort_order=desc.

after_occurred_at.description: Chronological cursor anchor for newer results. Pair with after_id. Only used when sort_by=date and sort_order=desc.

after_id.description: Stable tie-breaker for after_occurred_at. Only used when sort_by=date and sort_order=desc.

include_classification.description: Include classification data. Use "summary" to include aggregated classification stats for filter UI.

sort_by.description: Sort content by: date (newest first) or score (cross-platform smart ranking). Search queries respect date sorting for chronological feed browsing; score sorting remains relevance-weighted. Default: score

sort_order.description: Sort order: asc (ascending) or desc (descending). Default: desc

include_superseded.description: When true and listing entity content without a query, include superseded historical events in addition to current records. Useful for explicit historical lookups such as original or previous values.

classification_source.description: Filter content by classification source: user (manual), embedding (system), or llm (AI-generated)

content_ids.description: Filter to specific content IDs. Useful for showing content linked to watcher analysis.

exclude_watcher_id.description: Exclude content already analyzed in any window for this watcher. Returns only unprocessed content for client-driven watcher generation.

semantic_type.description: Filter by semantic type. Pass a single value (e.g. "note") or an array (e.g. ["note","summary"]) to match any. Matches the semantic_type set via save_memory.

entity_types.description: Org-wide filter: limit to events linked to entities whose type slug is in this list. Ignored when entity_id is set.

interaction_status.description: Filter by interaction status (e.g. "pending" for pending approvals)

tools.description: Read content/memory. SDK alternatives: search_memory, client.knowledge.search.

tools.name: manage_classifiers

entity_id.description: [create/list] Entity ID to scope classifiers (global if omitted)

watcher_id.description: [create] Watcher ID (required — classifiers must belong to a watcher)

attribute_values.description: [create] Attribute values with descriptions, examples, and optional embeddings.

fallback_value.description: [create] Fallback value if no match (default: null)

status.description: [list] Filter by status (active or deprecated)

classifications.description: [classify] Array of classifications to update (batch mode)

value.description: Classification value, or null to unset
[classify] Classification value for single update, or null to unset

tools.description: Classifier management. SDK alternative: client.classifiers.

tools.name: manage_view_templates

resource_type.description: Type of resource: entity_type or entity

resource_id.description: Resource identifier: entity type slug (string) or entity id (number)

json_template.description: [set] The JSON template content. May include a data_sources key: { "data_sources": { "name": { "query": "SELECT ... FROM entities" } }, ...template }. Queries run against org-scoped virtual tables. Use {{entityId}} for current entity context.

tab_name.description: Tab name. Omit for the default/overview tab.

tools.description: View-template management. SDK alternative: client.viewTemplates.

tools.name: resolve_path

include_bootstrap.description: When true, includes shared bootstrap data for sidebar and overview pages in the response

tools.description: Resolve a namespace-based URL path like /acme/entity-type/entity-slug into namespace and entity details. Returns template_data with executed data source query results when templates define data_sources.
